honesty: CORRECTED 2026-10-13 (the first version of this note was wrong). A real hard limit HAS been observed, but only in Claude Code's own interactive transcripts (~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl, two 'session limit' and two 'weekly limit' records, 2026-09-21 onward), not in a Flywheel session log and not as a stream-json line. That record is an assistant message carrying error 'rate_limit', isApiErrorMessage true, apiErrorStatus 429 and a `quotaLimits` object whose status is 'rejected'; it is frozen below as provenance 'observed-transcript'. It is the transcript's serialisation, so its field spelling (isApiErrorMessage, camelCase) may differ from the `-p --output-format stream-json` line the adapter reads (is_api_error_message). STILL UNOBSERVED: a top-level `rate_limit_event` line whose `rate_limit_info.status` is 'rejected'. Every shape of that kind is 'documented'. If a Flywheel session ever hits a limit, its raw line is in the session log: replace the matching documented entry and set provenance to 'observed'.
